gloss: to increase; to mount up; to pile up

definitions.explanation: For amounts, especially expenses or quantities, to accumulate and become larger.

definitions.gloss: to bulk up; to take up more space
definitions.explanation: For physical volume to increase or become bulky.

examples.japanese: {医療費|いりょうひ}が{嵩|かさ}んで{困|こま}っている。
examples.english: I'm struggling because my medical expenses keep mounting up.

examples.japanese: {予想|よそう}より{費用|ひよう}が{嵩|かさ}んだ。
examples.english: The costs mounted up more than expected.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}が{嵩|かさ}んで{持|も}ち{運|はこ}びにくい。
examples.english: The luggage has gotten bulky and is difficult to carry.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
{自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
Pattern: Xが{嵩|かさ}む

ASPECT (ている):
{嵩|かさ}んでいる - has accumulated (resultant state)

KANJI NOTE:
The kanji {嵩|かさ} is a rare character. This verb is often written in hiragana as かさむ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{費用|ひよう}が{嵩|かさ}む - expenses mount up
・{出費|しゅっぴ}が{嵩|かさ}む - spending increases
・{荷物|にもつ}が{嵩|かさ}む - luggage becomes bulky
・{年齢|ねんれい}が{嵩|かさ}む - to get older (literary)

NUANCE:
Often implies a negative connotation, especially when referring to expenses or problems accumulating beyond expectations.
